title: ISRO / DRDO scientist recruitment
kicker: Scientist, engineer and technical posts in space and defence research

value.body: ISRO and DRDO hire scientists and engineers (entry grade Scientist/Engineer 'SC' at ISRO, Scientist 'B' at DRDO) and technical support staff (scientific assistants, technical assistants, technicians). ISRO's centralised scientist recruitment runs through the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB); DRDO's scientist recruitment runs through its Recruitment and Assessment Centre (RAC), and technical staff through CEPTAM.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Scientist / engineer posts: a first-class B.E. / B.Tech (or M.Sc / M.E. for some disciplines). DRDO RAC shortlists mainly on a valid GATE score, then holds an interview; ISRO ICRB holds its own written / computer-based test followed by an interview. Technical posts: DRDO CEPTAM recruits STA-B (B.Sc or diploma) and Technician-A (Class 10 + ITI) through a CBT; ISRO centres advertise Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant and Technician posts separately.

value.title: At a glance
items: Posts are limited — typically tens to a few hundred per cycle per organisation — and spread across disciplines.
Not every discipline is advertised every year; ISRO and DRDO also hire through direct, project-based and lateral notifications at individual centres.
For DRDO scientist roles, a strong GATE score in the matching paper is the main shortlisting filter.
Both organisations have schemes for in-service M.Tech / PhD study.
